storage: Private immutable REVIEW_EVIDENCE checkpoints through the authenticated enrichment service; never a public projection or human decision store.
rules: Reference assessment is produced from a current source-only packet and persisted/read back before any proposal projection is supplied to the comparison step.
Comparison binds the exact candidate input, source snapshot, persisted reference digest and current privacy-filtered proposal revision.
These artefacts are assessment evidence only: they do not create calibration acceptance, human approval, canonical identity, public completion or validation.
No original source text, reviewer prose, private identifiers or credentials are emitted to public repository artefacts or logs.
